title: WORKSHEET 49
subject: Contrast: although, even though, though, in spite of,
subjectVi: Ngữ pháp bài 49: Contrast: although, even though, though, in spite of,

sections.instruction: Rephrase the sentences beginning with the words in brackets:

questions.prompt: She has plenty of money, but she is very mean. (although)
acceptedAnswers: Although she has plenty of money, she is very mean.

questions.prompt: They have a car, but they rarely use it. (though)
acceptedAnswers: Though they have a car, they rarely use it.

questions.prompt: He was innocent, but he was sent to prison. (although)
acceptedAnswers: Although he was innocent, he was sent to prison.

questions.prompt: He has a number of relatives living nearby, but he never visits them. (even though)
acceptedAnswers: Even though he has a number of relatives living nearby, he never visits them.

questions.prompt: She never takes any kind of exercise, but she is quite fit and healthy. (even though)
acceptedAnswers: Even though she never takes any kind of exercise, she is quite fit and healthy.

sections.instruction: Rephrase the sentences using the words in brackets and a noun:

questions.prompt: They went out for a walk, even though the weather was bad. (despite)
acceptedAnswers: They went out for a walk despite the bad weather.

questions.prompt: She managed to write, even though her hand was injured. (in spite of)
acceptedAnswers: She managed to write in spite of her injured hand.
She managed to write in spite of her hand injury.

questions.prompt: All the trains were on time, even though the snow was heavy. (despite)
acceptedAnswers: All the trains were on time despite the heavy snow.

questions.prompt: Our coach didn't arrive late, even though the traffic was terrible. (in spite of)
acceptedAnswers: Our coach didn't arrive late in spite of the terrible traffic.

questions.prompt: A lot of people buy those houses, even though the prices are high. (despite)
acceptedAnswers: A lot of people buy those houses despite the high prices.
A lot of people buy those houses despite their high prices.

questions.prompt: He stayed up late, even though he was very tired. (despite)
acceptedAnswers: He stayed up late despite his tiredness.
He stayed up late despite being very tired.
He stayed up late despite his great tiredness.

questions.prompt: I didn't buy the car, even though I had the money. (despite)
acceptedAnswers: I didn't buy the car despite having the money.
I didn't buy the car despite the fact that I had the money.

questions.prompt: He stayed outside in the cold weather, even though he felt ill. (despite)
acceptedAnswers: He stayed outside in the cold weather despite his illness.
He stayed outside in the cold weather despite feeling ill.

questions.prompt: People continue to smoke, even though they know the dangers. (in spite of)
acceptedAnswers: People continue to smoke in spite of the dangers.
People continue to smoke in spite of knowing the dangers.

sections.instruction: Sally and Peter are good friends, but they are very different. Compare Sally and Peter. Join each idea about Sally with the most suitable idea about Peter (list B). Make sentences using WHILE / WHEREAS. (Example: She likes hard work, while / whereas he's quite lazy.)
sections.contextText:
